name: ultraterrestrials

phase_0.boundary_condition: The Vallee-Davis six-layer model of physical and psychic effects.

VINIT.justification: The state of the multiverse before any interdimensional intrusion or observation occurs.

TANCH.justification: The final containment where the phenomenon and the observer merge into a single historical record.

AFWD.justification: The movement from higher-order hyperspace into the four-dimensional human perceptual frame.

AREV.justification: The return signal from the human witness that influences the behavior of the phenomenon.

CLINK.justification: The sequential chaining of physical traces and mental impressions into a coherent narrative.

IMSCRIB.justification: The phenomenon reflecting the cultural expectations and fears of the observer back to themselves.

FSPLIT.justification: The split of a single event into physical artifacts and subjective psychic experiences.

FFUSE.justification: The recombination of physical data and subjective witness testimony into a singular anomalous occurrence.

EVALT.justification: The successful manifestation of a craft or entity in physical space.

EVALF.justification: The intentional obfuscation or camouflage of the entity to prevent direct capture.

ENGAGR.justification: A condition where the phenomenon is simultaneously physical and illusory, defying binary classification.

IFIX.justification: The permanent fixation of the encounter into human folklore and collective memory.

phase_3.void_description: The unobserved plenum of potential dimensions.
phase_3.true_description: A verifiable physical interaction with measurable radiation or debris.
phase_3.false_description: A purely hallucinatory or deceptive screen memory with no external basis.
phase_3.both_description: A high-strangeness event where physical effects and psychic telepathy occur in tandem.

steps.domain_action: The pre-encounter state of the local environment remains undisturbed.
An ultraterrestrial entity initiates a descent from a higher dimensional frequency.
The entity enters the local frame, splitting its presence into a radar signature and a telepathic broadcast.
The radar signature hardens into a detectable physical object.
Ground sensors record the electromagnetic pulse as a permanent data point.
The telepathic broadcast generates a screen memory to confuse the witness.
The witness attempts to rationalize the screen memory, sending a cognitive signal back to the entity.
The physical object and the screen memory converge as the entity departs.
The witness links the physical burn marks on the ground with their internal sense of lost time.
The witness recognizes the encounter as a personal message directed at their own psyche.
The witness holds the contradiction of a solid craft that passed through a mountain as a single truth.
The encounter concludes, leaving a permanent scar on the local reality and the witness's biography.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The human nervous system acting as a transducer for non-human signals.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Telepathic resonance and modulated microwave emissions.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The collective unconscious and classified government databases.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The control system theory where encounters are timed to influence human social evolution.
phase_5.alfs_store: The historical record of fairy lore, religious visions, and modern urology.

phase_6.cycle_cost: Psychic energy and local electromagnetic stability.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: A modified reality containing a new permanent mythic element.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The energy lost to the local environment is captured and stored within the permanent cultural memory of the species.
